novel_mechanics_found: The mapped right color-15 pair was live-verified with exact phase synchronization: on L7 internal clock/action 40, the active player entered (49,37) on the same successful tick that clone 2 first occupied the remote plate at (49,1), and the populated response transferred the player to (49,49). The prior degenerate terminal was not evidence of bad phase timing. It is caused by apply_g50t_label's post-goal loop: the goal-moving env.step itself returns a populated GameState.WIN frame at levels_completed=7, but because qgzorkgosv remains true on the last level, the helper submits another post-WIN env.step and replaces that valid response with ARC Engine's empty terminal sentinel.
narrative: The required precondition resolved resolve_replay_plan({'game':'g50t','levels_reproduced':6}, Path('.')), constructed a brand-new arc.make('g50t') environment followed by one reset, and replayed the 288-label round-9 prefix. It advanced at full actions 17, 48, 118, 149, 204, and 288 and ended at level 6, GameState.NOT_FINISHED, with a populated frame. A second brand-new environment plus one reset replayed the same 288-label prefix for discovery. Every one of the first 42 L7 labels was then executed and inspected; all responses were populated, remained at level 6, and had plausible state. Clone 1's 10-move program used the left swap and parked at (13,1), holding the top gate open. Clone 2 recorded a 14-move program to (49,1). During the active replay, tail action 40 simultaneously put clone 2 on (49,1) and the player on (49,37); the returned 30-frame response showed the player transferred to (49,49), directly validating the right-pair phase synchronization. LEFT at actions 41 and 42 moved safely to (43,49) and (37,49). For the final LEFT, the primitive env.step was deliberately submitted exactly once instead of using apply_g50t_label's non-terminal-aware settling loop. That real call returned a normally populated 8-frame GameState.WIN response with levels_completed=7, win_levels=7, player=(31,49), internal clock=43, is_empty=false. This directly satisfies the win observation requirement. Total logical action submissions were 288 precondition + 288 discovery replay + 43 L7 = 619. Only 81 remained under the 700-step cap, less than the 331 needed for another fresh-reset full reproduction, so reproduction_verified is false.
gotchas: The 43 labels are mechanically correct, but the last label must not be passed through the current apply_g50t_label settling loop. Submit it once or make that helper stop immediately when its first response is GameState.WIN.

On the final goal move, ARC Engine returns a populated WIN response with levels_completed=7. A subsequent env.step after WIN returns an empty terminal sentinel; this is the exact source of round 11's false degenerate result.
The right swap fired live at tail action 40: after the populated response the player was at (49,49), clone 2 was at (49,1), and neither loss_latched nor goal_latched was set.
Clone 1's left-swap program has 10 successful moves; clone 2's right-trigger program has 14. The active player must reach (49,37) on active successful move 14.

All L7 responses through action 42 were checked for level, state, and frame population before continuing. Checkpoints were written at the prefix and tail actions 11, 26, 40, 42, and 43 to /tmp/round12_g50t_candidate.json.
Both the precondition and discovery runs used separate brand-new arc.make('g50t') environments followed by exactly one reset.
No third fresh-reset reproduction gate was attempted because it would require 331 more action submissions and exceed the 700-step session cap.
reproduction_verified=false means no independent post-discovery replay was run; it does not negate the directly observed populated WIN frame in the discovery run.
